The '''2024 Supercopa de España final''' was a [[Association football|football]] match to decide the winner of the [[2024 Supercopa de España]], the 40th edition of the annual Spanish football super cup competition. The match was played on 14 January 2024 at the [[King Saud University Stadium]] in [[Riyadh]], Saudi Arabia.<ref>{{cite web |title=This is what the Spanish Super Cup 2024 will look like|url=https://rfef.es/en/news/what-spanish-super-cup-2024-will-look |date=25 October 2023 |access-date=25 October 2023 |publisher=Royal Spanish Football Federation }}</ref> The match was '[[El Clásico]]' between the [[2022–23 Copa del Rey]] winners and [[2022–23 La Liga]] runners-up [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]], and the [[2022–23 La Liga]] winners [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]], the ninth time both clubs played each other in the competition's decisive tie (until [[2020 Supercopa de España|2020]] its format was simply a two-legged match); the teams also faced each other in the [[2023 Supercopa de España final|previous season's final]].

Real Madrid won the match 4–1 for their 13th Supercopa de España title.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://rfef.es/es/noticias/cronica-el-real-madrid-recupera-su-corona-en-la-supercopa-4-1 |title=Chronicle {{!}} El Real Madrid recupera su corona en la Supercopa (4–1) |trans-title=Real Madrid recovers its crown in the Super Cup (4–1) |work=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation]] |format=PDF |date=14 January 2024 |access-date=14 January 2024 |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.theguardian.com/football/2024/jan/14/real-madrid-barcelona-spanish-super-cup-final|title=Vinícius Júnior leads Real Madrid to Super Cup triumph over Barcelona|date=14 January 2024|work=Guardian|accessdate=16 January 2024}}</ref>

'''Match rules'''
*90 minutes.
*30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] if necessary.
*[[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|Penalty shoot-out]] if scores still level.
*Eleven named substitutes.
*Maximum of five substitutions, with a sixth allowed in extra time.{{refn|group=note|Each team was given only three opportunities to make substitutions, with a fourth opportunity in extra time, excluding substitutions made at half-time, before the start of extra time and at half-time in extra time.}}
